title: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco Concentrate pairs the deep richness of Tobacco with the fruity sharpness of Cherry, creating a distinctive DIY base flavour. The Tobacco note provides depth, while Cherry adds a sweet yet tart lift. Supplied in a 30ml bottle, this concentrate must be diluted before use. It is designed for experienced mixers who want full control over their VG/PG ratios and nicotine levels, making it versatile for custom e-liquids. Produced in the UK, Vampire Vape concentrates are recognised for their flavour consistency and trusted by DIY vapers worldwide.
